name: cg_coin_history
description:
A coin's snapshot on one past date from CoinGecko (coins/{id}/history): price, market cap and total volume in many currencies at 00:00 UTC that day.
Returns {id, symbol, name, market_data: {current_price: {currency: value}, market_cap: {...}, total_volume: {...}}, ...}.
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko coin id such as bitcoin or ethereum, not the ticker symbol; ids come from cg_search or cg_coin_list; default bitcoin), date* (string, DD-MM-YYYY, e.g. 31-12-2023).
For a series of days use cg_coin_market_chart or cg_coin_ohlc.
Example: {"id": "bitcoin", "date": "31-12-2023"}
No API key is sent (CoinGecko public API, rate-limited by CoinGecko); a failed call returns {"error": ...}.

id.description: CoinGecko coin id (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum), not the ticker symbol
